unclassified.reason: the dispatch table is walked only for the eleven commands the boot path uses (00 01 02 03 05 06 07 0B 0C 17 1B). Every other command below 1Fh is unexercised and unnamed.

this dump ends at 07FF. The 8KB variants (m88204 disk.rom, and Pc88.rom at 0x14000) agree with it byte for byte over 0000-07FF and then differ from EACH OTHER in 2021 of the remaining 6144 bytes — nothing here has looked above 0800.

notes:
Scope: the disk-boot path of the sub board, not a map of the ROM. Everything not listed is unclassified by default.

Confidence mapping: romlabels.js marks these entries "verified" (walked instruction by instruction). They appear here as `inferred` because this format reserves `observed` for claims with a recorded count — and the counts from those sessions were never written down. The one genuine `observed` entry is 02B4, whose 262144 iterations were measured against M88.

ROM revision: this document is stamped with the PC-8801mkII FR 2KB disk.rom. Measured on 2026-08-10: its 2048 bytes are identical to the first 2048 of m88204 disk.rom AND of Pc88.rom at 0x14000, so every label below (all under 0800) transfers to both. That is luck, not policy — the same two 8KB images differ in 2021 bytes overall, which is the harness defect recorded in docs/m88-comparison.md. Do not assume; compare the hash.
